description: Express.js route handlers for managing course requests, including listing pending requests, approving, rejecting, and removing courses with admin-only access control.

methods.name: GET /course-requests
methods.description: Fetches list of pending course requests, accessible only by admin.

methods.name: POST /course-requests/:courseId/approve
methods.description: Approves a pending course request, changing status to published and notifying instructor.

methods.name: POST /course-requests/:courseId/reject
methods.description: Rejects a pending course request with a reason, notifying instructor.

methods.name: POST /course-requests/:courseId/remove
methods.description: Removes (soft deletes) a course with a reason, notifying instructor.
